## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request links one issue (`Fixes #n`).
- [ ] The pull request targets `develop`. Only `release/` and `hotfix/` branches target `main`.
- [ ] The pull request does one change.
- [ ] The CI passes.
- [ ] A `port` or `refactor` pull request does not change behavior, except the changes that its issue lists.
- [ ] A `perf` pull request gives the benchmark results before and after the change.
- [ ] The text follows STE100 (docs/STYLE.md).
